name: Opencode Agents
description: Ships the complete primary agentic setup + library (AGENTS.md / AGENTS_LIFECYCLE.md, .opencode/agent/*.md, generic skills, library/ reference books). Consumer-extensible + opt-out via WITH_LIBRARY option.

OVERWRITE.description: Refresh existing scaffold files in the workspace, restricted to shipped-file manifest, never consumer files

WITH_LIBRARY.description: Ship library books (true) or leave only extension docs + empty register (false = opt-out)

INSTALL_DIR.description: Directory where agentic payload is unpacked
